### 📸 LongShot — Seamless Long Screenshots for iOS

Take scrolling, vertically stitched long screenshots in any iOS app with a single tap!

#### ✨ Key Features
- 🎨 **Apple Preview & Redaction Studio:** Fullscreen interactive liquid glass studio to review, pan, zoom, or redact screenshots before saving to Photos.
- 🛡️ **5 Redaction Styles:** Solid Black, Gaussian Blur, Frosted Glass, on-device AI Auto-Detect (Vision OCR for cards, IBAN, phones, OTP, ID, QR), and Instant Undo.
- 🚀 **One-Tap Long Shot:** Automatically scrolls scrollable views (Safari, Twitter, WhatsApp, Settings, Reddit, etc.) and stitches them seamlessly.
- 🖐️ **Manual ('Elle') Mode:** Floating capsule HUD allows step-by-step custom scrolling and capture.
- 🛑 **Live Stop Control:** Press 'Durdur' anytime to finalize and stitch slices up to that exact point without blank trailing space.
- 📊 **Status Bar Header:** Long screenshots keep the real status bar (clock, battery, signal) at the top — toggleable in Settings.
- 🖼️ **Hide iOS Thumbnail Preview:** Optional Settings toggle to hide the stock iOS bottom-left screenshot preview popup.
- 🌐 **11-Language Dynamic Localization:** Native UI in EN, TR, DE, FR, ES, IT, RU, JA, ZH-Hans, AR, and VI.
- 💾 **Instant Save & Share:** Directly saves high-resolution stitched images to your Photos Library and opens native UIActivityViewController.
- ⚙️ **Native iOS Settings Integration:** Full control panel with diagnostics, Telegram log reporting, and customization.
- 🛡️ **100% Free Community Release:** Strictly not for sale.

#### 📱 Compatibility
- **Jailbreak:** Dopamine 2 (Rootless, `/var/jb`)
- **Firmware:** iOS 15.0 – 17.0
- **Architecture:** `iphoneos-arm64` (A10–A16 devices)

#### Version 2.0.0
- 🎨 Apple Önizleme Stüdyosu (Preview Studio): Çekilen görüntüyü kaydetmeden önce inceleme ve düzenleme imkanı.
- 🛡️ 5 Farklı Sansürleme Modu: Siyah, Bulanık, Buzlu Cam, Yapay Zeka Otomatik Tarama ve Geri Al.
- ✨ Akıcı Sıvı Cam Araç Çubuğu: Yatay kaydırılabilir, elastik geri sekme fiziklerine ve keşif peek animasyonuna sahip Apple tasarım çip barı.
- 🔍 1:1 Tam Retina Netliği: Önizleme stüdyosunda standart ekran görüntüleri artık tam Retina çözünürlüğünde kristal netliğinde görüntülenir.
- 👆 Sezgisel Hareketler: Tek parmakla sansür alanı seçimi, iki parmakla 1x-4x serbest yakınlaştırma (zoom) ve kaydırma.
- 🌐 11 Global Dil Desteği: TR, EN, DE, FR, ES, IT, RU, JA, ZH-Hans, AR, VI için %100 dinamik yerelleştirme.
- ⚡ Oturum Güvenliği: Önizlemeden sonra tekrar yakalama yapıldığında butonların gelmemesi sorunu tamamen çözüldü.

#### Version 1.2.0
- NEW: Automatic privacy redaction. Before a long screenshot is saved or shared, it is scanned on-device and sensitive areas are covered with opaque black boxes.
- Detects card numbers (Luhn + issuer check), IBAN (mod-97), phone numbers, verification codes (OTP), Turkish ID numbers (TCKN), QR/barcodes, e-mail addresses and faces.
- Banded Vision scan (2048 px slices with overlap) so small text in a 40.000 px stitch is still readable to the OCR engine.
- New 'Privacy & Redaction' section in Settings with per-category switches, localized in all 11 languages.
- Fail-safe: if a scan fails you are asked explicitly before anything is written to Photos. Nothing leaves the device, nothing is uploaded.
- Fixed stale 1.1.2 version string inside the Settings bundle Info.plist.

#### Version 1.1.3
- ✂️ **No More Cut Top:** Long screenshots now begin exactly where the screen does - navigation bars, large titles and search fields are kept instead of being clipped away.
- 📊 **Real Status Bar:** The top band comes from the actual display, so clock, battery and signal icons are pixel-accurate and the flat gray strip behind them is gone.
- 🎯 **Automatic Alignment:** The top is matched against the live screen, so tall headers and floating search fields line up in both Auto and Manual capture.

#### Version 1.1.2
- 📊 **Status Bar Included:** Long screenshots keep the real status bar (clock, battery, signal icons) at the top instead of cropping it off.
- 🎛️ **New 'Include Status Bar' Toggle:** Settings switch (on by default) to prepend or skip the status bar, localized in all 11 languages.
- ♻️ **Both Capture Modes:** The header applies to Auto and Manual stitches, and is skipped automatically when the status bar is hidden.

#### Version 1.1.1
- 🚀 **Fixed Process Name Resolution:** Resolved dyld startup timing issue where early injection showed 'injected into ?' in diagnostic reports.
- 🛡️ **Daemon Filter Hardening:** Completely eliminated background daemon injection overhead in non-UI services (backupd, remindd, PosterBoard).
- ⚙️ **Settings Dynamic Versioning:** Version string now resolves dynamically from bundle metadata.

#### Version 1.1.0
- 🖼️ **Fixed 'Hide iOS Screenshot Preview':** Stock bottom-left preview thumbnail is now reliably hidden when enabled, and instantly restored when disabled without glitches.
- ⚡ **Respring Button:** Added a dedicated Respring button in the Settings menu and navigation bar to restart SpringBoard at will.
- 🛠️ **Stability Improvements:** Hardened SpringBoard hooks with safe runtime registration preventing any crashes.

#### Version 1.0.1
- 🌐 **Full English & Turkish Localizations:** Settings panel and HUD elements automatically adapt to your device language (Manual / Elle, Stop / Durdur, Save / Share alerts).
- 💬 **Developer Note:** Added a one-time welcome notice upon installation.
- ⚙️ **SpringBoard Compatibility:** Enhanced system-wide hooks for smooth startup.

#### Version 1.0.0
- Initial public release on Doguner Repo!
- Chained main-runloop scroll-and-capture state machine.
- Floating interactive prompt capsule with instant dismiss (✕), 'Long Shot' (Auto), and 'Elle' (Manual).
- Floating capture HUD with live slice counter and responsive 'Durdur' (Stop) button.
- Native Settings app integration with toggle, log reporting to Telegram, and stock preview suppression.
